key_insight: Simulation-driven optimization improved hydrofoil efficiency, with adjoint refinement of the conventional design yielding a reported 15% increase.
engineering_relevance: CFD-based optimization offers a systematic alternative to intuition-led hydrofoil tuning for foil windsurfing.
method: Digitize a conventional hydrofoil using structured-light scanning and explore five aircraft-wing-inspired designs.
Use design-of-experiments simulations to train a machine-learning surrogate for multi-objective optimization.
Apply adjoint optimization to explore shape changes beyond the surrogate’s restricted design parameters.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation-based performance gains, including a 15% efficiency increase from adjoint optimization, but does not describe physical validation.
watch_item: Performance gains apply under specific conditions; practical designs require realistic constraints and validation across operating conditions.
paper_title: Improving Hydrofoil Efficiency Through Simulation-Driven Design Optimization
